title: IVG Pro 12 Kiwi Passionfruit Guava Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: Kiwi Passionfruit Guava IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pods deliver a layered tropical vape, combining the tangy brightness of Kiwi and Passionfruit with the soft, mellow sweetness of Guava. It's a flavour-packed profile with depth and balance, ideal for fruit fans. Each refill pack includes a 2ml pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a separate 10ml refill reservoir. Once assembled, the refill system automatically tops up the pod as you vape, supporting up to 10,000 puffs per kit with no refilling or coil replacements. Mesh coil technology ensures smooth MTL vapour and full flavour delivery across the life of the pod. These pods are made exclusively for use with the IVG Pro 12 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. How to Set Up: Remove the red stoppers from the 2ml pod. Twist and remove the red safety cap from the 10ml refill reservoir. Insert the pod into the refill reservoir and press until they click into place. Slide the connected pod and refill unit into the device. Wait a few moments to allow the coil to saturate before vaping.
